title: Nashville Luxury 2 King-BR | Pool | Gym | Parking
description:
Welcome to your perfect Luxury Nashville getaway! This stunning 2-bedroom/2-full bath, 2-king suite is located in Midtown, minutes from downtown, Music Row, and The Gulch. Featuring high-end modern luxury finishes, a spacious living area, fully equipped kitchen, and in-unit laundry. Enjoy access to a pool, sky lounge, gym, and parking ($12/night). Whether here for a weekend escape, business trip, or special event, this upscale retreat has everything you need for an unforgettable Nashville stay.

The space
✨ The Space:
✔ Spacious Living Area – Relax in a beautifully furnished open-concept living space with a smart TV, cozy seating, and plenty of natural light. 
✔ Fully Equipped Kitchen – Cook up your favorites in a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and all essentials.
✔ Master Bedroom – Features a King-sized bed, en-suite bathroom, and walk-in closet for ultimate convenience.
✔ Second Bedroom – Equipped with a comfortable King-sized bed and plenty of storage.
✔ Two Full Bathrooms – Modern and stylish with fresh linens, toiletries, and spa-like touches.
✔ Washer & Dryer – In-unit for added convenience.
✔ Fast WiFi & Smart TVs – Stream your favorite shows or catch up on work with high-speed internet.
✔ On-Site Gated Parking ($12/Day) -- MUST BE ARRANGED BEFORE HAND 

⭐ Location Highlights:
✅ 5 minutes to Broadway & Downtown Nashville
✅ Close to The Gulch, Music Row & Vanderbilt University
✅ Walking distance to trendy cafes, bars, and local shops
✅ Quick access to Centennial Park, Marathon Village, and Nissan Stadium

 🔥 Exclusive Guest Amenities:

• Keyless Entry System for Secure and Convenient Access
• Climate Control for Your Comfort
• In-Unit Laundry Facilities
• Gated Parking ($12/day) 
• Detailed Guidebook with Local Recommendations
• 4K HDTVs with Netflix 
• High-speed WiFi
• Laptop friendly workspace
• Ideal for long-term stays
• Washer + dryer w/ detergent
• Dishwasher w/ detergent
• Keurig with coffee
• Central A/C & Heat
• Club house and community Pool with outdoor grill area access
• SKY LOUNGE/GAME room access (inc. Pool Table, Poker Table, Foosball Table)
• WIFI ACCESS THROUGHOUT ENTIRE BUILDING

📌 Additional Details:
✔ Self-Check-In with Smart Lock for an easy, seamless arrival
✔ Professionally Cleaned & Stocked with Essentials
✔ Perfect for Couples, Families, or Business Travelers

Book now and experience Music City like a local! 🎶✨

Guest access
Our Guests have free access to the following amenities:

• Club House and Outdoor Resort-Style Swimming Pool*
• Poolside Grill Area
• 10th Floor Sky Lounge/Game room (inc. Pool table, Poker Table, Foosball Table) 
• Fitness Center w/ Yoga Studio & Cardio Room

*PLEASE NOTE: While we provide access to the building's pool for our guests, it is occasionally closed for maintenance or seasonal issues at the building's discretion. We will not be held responsible if the pool is closed during your trip. We recommend that you contact us to confirm that it is open.

Other things to note
For your safety, we have an exterior camera at the property that monitors the front entrance.
